title: sec: unbounded collections allow memory exhaustion DoS
description: add_peer() (line 283), add_candidate() (line 829), and receive_from_peer() (line 548) have no size limits. Add MAX_PEERS, MAX_CANDIDATES constants and enforce them to prevent resource exhaustion attacks.
close_reason: Fixed: added MAX_PEERS (64), MAX_CANDIDATES (32), MAX_RECEIVED_ROUTE_PEERS (64) constants and enforced size limits in add_peer(), add_candidate(), and receive_from_peer() to prevent memory exhaustion DoS attacks
